summary: Enhance your expertise with our Advanced AML & CTF training course. Learn about regulations, compliance, and effective crime prevention strategies.
lede: AML and CTF training helps experienced financial-crime professionals assess risk and apply customer due diligence, monitoring and investigation controls. It covers customer and beneficial-ownership risk, transaction-alert analysis, sanctions screening and investigation documentation. Participants also practise escalation, control testing and management reporting to support consistent, evidence-based decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with AML and CTF controls or related financial crime responsibilities. It suits experienced practitioners who need to strengthen risk assessment, investigation quality, sanctions decision-making, and evidence-based reporting across banking, payments, insurance, investment, professional services, and other regulated environments.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of AML compliance, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, or financial crime investigations. No programming is required. Familiarity with internal policies, case-management records, or compliance reporting will help you apply the exercises more effectively. Advanced analytics, AI-assisted triage, and automation are covered at operational application and governance levels, not the technical engineering level.
